verdict.rationale: Greptile documents a security check that pairs static scanning with an AI security agent to catch vulnerabilities in every pull request. It adds software composition analysis against known vulnerability databases, and this runs alongside its core bug-finding PR review. A community user confirms it catches real issues in PRs, though not specifically security ones. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of injection-risk and leaked-secret detection, and independent or hands-on corroboration of security findings in reviews.
